release_notes:
v2.0.5835 – Sandtime.io Reliability Update, Live Debug Log & Timer Safeguards

🔹 Sandtime.io API Overhaul (Critical Fix):
- Migrated from deprecated /auth/me endpoint to the official /organization endpoint.
- Added Accept: application/json header per Sandtime.io API documentation.
- Authentication no longer requires an email field to succeed – falls back to /users or org name automatically.
- Detailed error reporting: INVALID_KEY (401), FORBIDDEN (403), WRONG_BASE_URL (404), TIMEOUT, CONNECTION_ERROR now show the exact reason in the popup.
- Fixes the recurring 'Invalid API Key' false alarm that appeared even with a valid key.

🔹 Live Sandtime.io Debug Log (New):
- 🔍 View Logs button added to the Time Tracking panel – visible to ALL users.
- Live popup window with color-coded rows: SUCCESS, INFO, API, WARN, ERROR.
- Filter checkboxes per log level, Pause Live, Save to File, and Clear buttons.
- Every API call logged with method, endpoint, HTTP status, and response time in milliseconds.
- Log file auto-truncates on startup: %LOCALAPPDATA%\AI_Annotation_Master\logs\sandtime_debug.log always reflects the current session.
- Survives crashes – whatever was logged up to the moment of a crash stays on disk for forensics.

🔹 Timer Safeguards (New):
- 65-second startup cooldown: Stop button is locked with a live countdown (⏹ Stop 1:05 → 0:01) to prevent accidental immediate stops.
- 30-second post-stop lockout: Start button shows ▶ Start (0:30) countdown after every Stop, giving Sandtime's servers time to sync.
- Pause button is now permanently disabled (reserved for a future update).
- AFK auto-pause still works in the background (5-minute idle), but respects the 30s resume buffer.

🔹 Desync Detection (New):
- Background reconciliation timer runs every 30 seconds while tracking.
- Compares local tool state against Sandtime.io server state.
- If the server reports no pending activity but the tool thinks the timer is running, it logs a DESYNC DETECTED error.
- After two consecutive misses (60s of desync), the tool auto-resets to match the server and shows a clear warning.
- Fixes the bug where the tracker silently stopped on the dashboard but kept running in the tool.

🔹 Team Sheet Board (Unchanged):
- Race Condition Prevention with claim timestamps.
- Dominance timestamps: if your claim is older than a latecomer's, you win.
- fight_back_claim() and double-check armor preserved.
- All previous features fully intact.

🔹 Compatibility:
- Fully backwards compatible with existing team_kanban_board.json and team_settings.json.
- All existing API keys from Settings > Integrations > API continue to work.
- No changes needed to your MEGA folder structure.
